ns2:course.label: Viola
ns2:course.description: Instruction in viola at the undergraduate level. Additional fees may apply. See Class Schedule. May be repeated in separate terms to a maximum of 16 hours. Prerequisite: Passing of a performance audition is required prior to the initial registration in any applied music course. Music majors must register concurrently in MUS 250.
